title: Development Tribunal decision 21-055: Class 6 alterations; fast-response sprinkler requirement disputed; Building Act s 68 transitional provisions (Stanthorpe)
jurisdiction: Queensland, Australia. COMPARATIVE TEST ONLY: not Alberta; no Alberta applicability asserted.
code_edition: National Construction Code Series, BCA Volume 1, 2019, as cited (para 42, p. 5); Building Act 1975 ss 68 and 112 transitional provisions (p. 8)
document_type: Development Tribunal decision notice (Planning Act 2016 s 255), Queensland
document_date: Decision notice dated 16 Dec 2022 (PDF p. 9); hearing 26 Apr 2022 (p. 1)

facts.text: QFES, as advice agency, appealed the assessment manager's decision to issue a building development approval for alterations at a site in Stanthorpe.
The alterations are to a Class 6 tenancy in a building originally constructed about 1980, which has a rise in storeys.
Decision Notice BP-9702 is dated 27 Aug 2021.

QFES's recorded position: the decision did not take account of Omnii fire engineering report Revision B (28 May 2021) and a fire engineering due diligence letter, and the omission of 'fast-response sprinklers' that Revision B required.
An updated Omnii report, Revision C dated 8 Oct 2021, is in the record.

The assessment manager applied Building Act ss 61, 68 and 86, and relied on s 68 and a fire engineering due diligence assessment that treated the works under the transitional provisions (ss 68 and 112).
The tribunal upheld the appeal and replaced the decision not to incorporate fast-response sprinklers with a decision to accept and act on the referral agency's assessment advice.
